Create & Manage Test Series

Create MCQ tests, preview questions, save drafts and publish tests for students.

Folder Details

Choose Common to make this test available to students of every branch. Student reader must include Common tests in its branch filter.
Example: 0.25 means −0.25 for a wrong answer.

MCQ Input

Supported format: 1. Question → A/B/C/D options → Answer: B. Markdown bold is automatically removed.
Multi-unit mode: paste one subject containing UNIT-1, UNIT-2 headings. Each unit will be created as a separate test under the same Subject and categorized by Unit/Topic.

Question Preview

Questions will appear here after Auto Create.

Auto Generated Test Data

Data is saved under testSeries/{testId}. Published tests use status: published and active: true.
